about: Reference clips for Roof Jumps' movement and feel (not its look). Labels are ours: what is seen, where, by time from the clip's start (s). Moves use the parkour names where they apply; 'ours' maps a segment to the runner's move or state. Clips and frames are never committed: devtools/refs.mjs makes them again into devtools/out/refs/.

clips.author: 梔虚月 (@KYOGETSU_2026)
clips.title: 空間の連続性を検証中
clips.notes: The first reference (Roof Jumps' first slice, before this manifest). Its URL was not recorded. One take, close behind a figure crossing low crowded rooftops over rails and units, arms straight out in the air, then sinking down an alley to the street. Taken from it: the eye (close behind, a little above, wide), the city's grain, the lightness (the glide).

clips.author: 梔虚月 (@KYOGETSU_2026)
clips.title: おはようございます！ 忘れ物を取りに戻ります
clips.titleEn: Good morning! Going back for something I forgot
clips.source: 1280x720, 24 fps; AI-generated (by the author's account, made with Kling)
clips.notes: A figure sprints along a street, steps up onto a ledge, climbs a zig-zag fire escape by springing rail to rail straight up through the flights (a storey a beat), reaches the roof, walks to her bag. The eye is wide and nearly still for the climb: everything reads in silhouette. Studied 2026-11-19: the climb chain, the bound's length change, the landing beat came from it.

segments.label: walk to sprint
segments.notes: walk to full lean in ~0.4 s; pitched 35-40 deg forward, low, long stride

segments.label: step up onto a ledge, load, up
segments.notes: off one foot 1.50-1.65, knee driven, arms reaching; airborne ~0.25 s; lands on the ledge ~1.80 and keeps going: two steps, a deep load 2.08-2.17 (~0.1 s), up onto the stairs 2.2

segments.label: fire escape: a storey a beat
segments.notes: about 1.1 s a storey, nearly identical each time

segments.label: one storey at 24 fps
segments.notes: steps 7.34-7.80 (~0.45 s, 3 crouched steps); load 7.84-8.05 (~0.2 s); full-length reach for the rail above 8.09-8.30 (~0.2 s); pull up into a tuck 8.34-8.47 (~0.15 s); onto the next flight 8.5

segments.label: roof arrival, settle, the bag
segments.notes: reach to the parapet 16.1-16.3; over it tucked 16.5; deep crouch on landing 16.9; up 17.1; in about a second down to a walk 17.5-18.3; bends for the bag 18.5

clips.title: おはようございます！ Kling4.0のアニメーションをテスト中です♥
clips.source: 1280x720, 24 fps; AI-generated with Kling 4.0, from the prompt in refs/kyo-kling-parkour.prompt.md (eight shots planned; seven given in the prompt as shared)
clips.notes: A cut sequence, not one take: eight shots, each a named parkour move, the eye changing every 1.5-2 s. Labelled 2026-11-19 against the prompt's shot list; where what's seen differs from what was asked, the label says what's seen.

segments.label: over a block: a high spread leap
segments.notes: asked a kong; seen a high leap, arms spread wide, symmetric: more display than vault

segments.label: up an alley wall to wall
segments.notes: hands and feet on both walls, rising between them: a kick off one side about every 0.25 s, 1.60-3.35

segments.label: cat leap, hang, mantle
segments.notes: leap 3.48-3.73; a hand on the top ~3.82; hanging, the feet walking up the wall, 3.90-4.30; over 4.40-4.98

segments.label: across a gap, turned over tucked
segments.notes: a tucked ball at the top ~6.75, arms out to land ~7.0

under a pipe, side flip, past the eye

the last leap: dive and flip onto the far roof
